harness.note: probe observations (FFX-G01 section 4.3): the real per-target calculation 0x789740 on the real Overdrive command records with the target fields random (seed 5) and swept one at a time; out.b16 is byte 0x16 of the first-pass record, the count of riders newly inflicted. Not a comparison with an independent model of the whole function: the rule is mapped for the swept inputs only.

description: Byte 0x16 of a Bushido's first-pass record per target: the count that sends a clean Bushido to its (Immune) row when it is 0.
notes: in.move is the move; in.perm, in.extra, in.extraImmune are the target's permanent word, extra word and extra-immunity word; in.delayImmune the delay-immunity byte; in.breaks the four Break resistance bytes.
class riderPetrified: the target carries Petrify, which the rule does not map (FFX-G01 open question 6); the test only counts how many disagree.
Dragon Fang: six of 1,431 random non-Petrified targets in the probe give 0 where the rule gives 1 (all carry permanent-status bits); they are kept in the file and the test counts them.
name: bushido_rider
